lines.scope_summary: Secure an exterior construction camera with a solar panel for site monitoring.
lines.verbatim_quote: Landlord will secure one (1) 12 Megapixel Cobalt Exterior OxBlue Construction Camera with Solar panel (optional).

lines.scope_summary: Obtain planning and zoning approval, land entitlements, and pay impact fees for site improvements.
lines.verbatim_quote: Landlord shall be responsible for planning and zoning approval, land entitlements, and all associated impact fees associated with Site improvements.

lines.scope_summary: Selective demolition is not required or applicable.
Provide concrete footings and anchor bolts for approved signage.
lines.verbatim_quote: Landlord shall provide concrete footings with specified anchor bolts in accordance with tenant's approved signage.

lines.scope_summary: Provide a concrete slab with leave-outs for tenant-provided fixtures.
lines.verbatim_quote: Landlord shall provide concrete slab with 18” dia. “leave outs” for tenant provided fixtures.

lines.scope_summary: Install a vapor barrier under all interior slabs-on-grade.
lines.verbatim_quote: Provide 15 mil under slab vapor barrier under all interior slabs-on-grade.

lines.scope_summary: Provide a monument or pylon sign built to the maximum allowable height.
lines.verbatim_quote: Landlord to provide [MONUMENT] or [PYLON] to the maximum allowable height [INSERT HEIGHT] per code or otherwise approved by Tenant.

lines.scope_summary: Install mailbox according to local jurisdictional requirements.
lines.verbatim_quote: Mailbox shall be installed by Landlord and placed per jurisdictional requirements.

lines.scope_summary: Furnish and install an independent domestic water meter with bypass and shut-off valves.
lines.verbatim_quote:
Permit, furnish, install at rear of Tenant’s space isolated from electrical equipment a minimum: 
• One [1] 1½”(min.) independent domestic water meter, designated for Tenant's use, with shut-off valves on either side and bypass valving for maintenance.

lines.scope_summary: Install a hydro-mechanical interceptor below grade with plumbing fixture connections.
lines.verbatim_quote: The Landlord shall install a minimum sized GB75 Hydro-Mechanical interceptor below grade, with connections to plumbing fixtures/floor sinks as required by the authority having jurisdiction.

lines.scope_summary: Provide vehicular paving for drive-thru lanes, parking areas, and drive aisles.
lines.verbatim_quote: Landlord shall be responsible for vehicular paving including drive thru lanes, parking, and drive aisles.

lines.scope_summary: Provide sealed concrete paving at the trash enclosure location.
lines.verbatim_quote: Provide 6" thick sealed concrete paving at trash enclosure.

lines.scope_summary: Provide cast in place sidewalks, curbs, curb cuts, retainage walls, ramps, and stairs.
lines.verbatim_quote: Hardscape: Landlord shall provide cast in place sidewalks, curbs, curb cuts, landscape retainage, ramps, and/or stairs as needed to ensure onsite pedestrian and vehicular access.

lines.scope_summary: Provide striping, accessible markings, and wayfinding graphics in the parking lot and drive thru.
lines.verbatim_quote: Provide parking lot pavement markings including accessible markings, stall striping, site and drive thru wayfinding graphics per jurisdictional requirements, and as defined in Starbucks tenant criteria package.

lines.scope_summary: Wheel stops are not applicable for this project's parking layout.
Provide a trash enclosure sized for specified refuse and recycling containers.
lines.verbatim_quote: Required Dimensions: Provide a trash enclosure minimal interior clear 15'-4" wide x 11’'-8" deep x 10’-0" high, with space inside to accommodate (2) four (4) cubic yard trash containers, and two [2] sixty-four (64) gallon containers.

lines.scope_summary: Furnish and install a compliant irrigation system.
lines.verbatim_quote: Installation: Landlord shall furnish and install irrigation system in compliance with tenant provided irrigation standards and local regulations.

lines.scope_summary: Furnish and install landscaping per tenant standards and local regulations.
lines.verbatim_quote: Planting Design: Landlord shall furnish and install landscape in compliance with tenant provided landscape standards and local regulations.
